# stb_image_write

`stb_image_write.h` v1.16 by Sean Barrett, from https://github.com/nothings/stb
(file `stb_image_write.h`, downloaded 2026-11-02). Public domain / MIT, at your
option; the license text is at the end of the header.

Used for PNG output only. `stb_image_write.cpp` is ours: it defines
`STB_IMAGE_WRITE_IMPLEMENTATION` and includes the header once.
